decisions.reason: The 518 FLEX was publicly relaunched and renamed from an established model with a loyal user base, so the firm's visible commitment and the product's evolutionary investment favor keeping it.
The AK series was publicly upgraded to EU Stage V engines at a trade fair, a recent sunk investment that ties it closely to the firm's core mobile shredding line.

The mobile high-speed grinder was promoted to its own page in 2019 and fits the firm's mobile processing direction, so disappointing results can still be attributed to temporary market causes such as the pandemic.

Management publicly claimed the new CERON generation sets benchmarks and showcased it in reference plants, making withdrawal hard to justify given the firm's announced push toward tougher stationary processing requirements.
